prerequisites.network: Not required to install; required only for optional model downloads and online catalog data
prerequisites.ffmpeg: Optional for video posters and mock video
prerequisites.node: Not required when using an official installer

data_policy.update: Application files are replaced without changing user data
data_policy.rollback: Install an earlier application release without changing user data
data_policy.uninstall: Application files are removed; user data is preserved unless purge is explicit
